Maya: Rugby sevens final tonight — who wants to meet up at The Sailor's Knot? $10 pool for the winner (beer tab). Kickoff 7:30pm. :rugby_football: :beer:
Ryan: I'm in. Can I bring a +1? Also my fantasy captain for the week is injured, can we do a quick sub poll? :grimacing:
Sam: Count me in. I can bring snacks. If pizza's cheaper for the group I'm volunteering to order :pizza:
Jess: Love it. Also can we set a tiebreaker? total tries scored sounds fun :thinking_face:
Alex: I'll run the pool. Spreadsheet here: https://short.link/rugby-pool (pw: redwood123). Reply with your pick in the sheet or DM me.
Lina: @calendar-bot please add this to my calendar for tonight 7pm meet in lobby -> pub.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Rugby Sevens — Sailor's Knot meetup" 2026-03-23T19:00Z. Reminder at 60m.
Ryan: Nice, thanks bot. Also quick rule: last-minute swaps allowed until kickoff.
Jess: Also who are we rooting for? The Rowdies or the Wanderers? I have embarrassing face paint ready if needed :face_paint:
Maya: Team is officially "Redwood Rowdies". Jess you have the face paint duty. :star_struck:
Alex: Quick poll: meet in lobby at 7:00 or at the pub at 7:15? React with :one: for lobby, :two: for pub.
Sam: :one: (lobby). Saves me the stairs.
Ryan: :two: if folks want me to secure a table, otherwise lobby works.
Jess: :one: — grabbing snacks first.
Lina: :one: added.
Alex: Cool — lobby 7. I'll print a tiny rules blurb and bring cash box. See you all later. :thumbsup:
Maya: Awesome. If anyone wants to carpool from SoMa ping me. Might grab an extra pizza if numbers >8.
Jess: @Maya sign me up for pizza. I'll Venmo.
Ryan: Same. Also last year the Rowdies pulled off the greatest upset, calling it now.
Sam: Bet. @Alex add "most ridiculous cheer" side-bet. Loser buys coffee Monday.
Alex: Done. Added column in sheet. Good luck, Rowdies.
Lina: See you tonight! :rugby_football::pizza:
